judgment_refs.phrase: Such a rate of speed as to endanger the life, limb or property of any person
judgment_refs.note: Measure original subject speed, person/property body gap and contact; no numeric legal endangerment threshold is inferred.

axes.range_rationale: Existing exact pedestrian placement probes at 0.4 and 2.0 m bound a nonduplicate interior lateral range; actual body clearance is retained from original polygons.
axes.spacing_rationale: Three fixed interior placements at 0.6, 1.2 and 1.8 m cover near, middle and farther exposure without a legal cutoff.
axes.feasibility_evidence: exposure_case_setup.py places the exposed actor at waypoint 4 (10 m); its exact 0.4/2.0 m offsets and both route directions are CPU tested. The interior offsets use the same spawn geometry.

sweep_specs.rationale: Finite original-body clearance sampling at fixed 5 m/s requested pedestrian exposure complements the existing 2/5/8 m/s requested-speed comparisons; legal endangerment remains unresolved.
